fields.description: Discovered during unrelated verification on 2026-08-09: just check-full stopped at fmt-md-check before code tests. The Markdown gate ran node_modules/.bin/prettier --check **/*.md and reported a warning for sase/memory/build_and_run.md plus Code style issues found in the above file. git status --short -- sase/memory/build_and_run.md and git diff -- sase/memory/build_and_run.md were clean, so this is a pre-existing protected memory-note formatting issue, not part of the ACE post-write noninteractive change. Scope: after explicit user permission for the memory edit, apply the minimal Prettier-compatible formatting to sase/memory/build_and_run.md, run sase memory init to regenerate AGENTS.md/provider shims/README, and rerun the Markdown formatting gate.

payload.entry: NO LONGER REPRODUCES at master ee9603d31: `just fmt-md-check` (prettier --check '**/*.md') passes clean, so the build_and_run.md line-wrap drift this bead tracks is gone — commit 0c2d5dd71 'chore: format build_and_run.md' reformatted the file. Verified by sase-ib.land while landing epic sase-ib (phase sase-ib.3 filed this bead, and phase sase-ib.7 recorded the same drift as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP). If the generator itself still emits non-prettier output, that residual concern is worth keeping; the blocking symptom is not.
